profile: Cantargia AB (publ) is a Swedish biotechnology company developing antibody-based treatments targeting IL1RAP. Its lead oncology program, nadunolimab (CAN04), is in clinical development for cancers including pancreatic, lung, and triple-negative breast cancer. The company also has programs for inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, and CAN10 was acquired by Otsuka Pharmaceutical in 2025.
